messages:
sam: Heads-up: were locking the social plan for the "May product upgrade" launch. Need final copy for X and LinkedIn, plus which assets (gif vs static), a 2-variant CTA test, and instructions for routing inbound signups to HubSpot. Who can own drafts?

ria: I can take LinkedIn long-form + carousel frames. Will include an executive quote and a short customer stat. Which hashtags do we want? #LLM #Inference #RedwoodLaunch?

oscar: I'll do X short + 1 thread (3 tweets) focused on latency/cost wins. CTA variants: 1) "See the demo" 2) "Try the new API". Also recommend pin a reply with a short signup form link.

tess: I'll handle assets. We have a motion GIF (demo capture) and 2 static thumbnails (engineer and product snapshots). My recommendation: GIF for X organic, static for LinkedIn carousel, thumbnail A for paid creative.

sam: @oscar love the CTA options. Add utm params: utm_source=x_social, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=may_upgrade. For paid we'll add utm_content=paid_a or paid_b.

oscar: noted. I'll produce the thread w/ both CTAs and a pinned-reply script.

ria: Has anyone drafted reply templates for engagement? We should have short SDR scripts for comments and DMs.

tess: I'll add 3 reply templates in the assets folder: 1) Thanks + link to demo, 2) Quick qualifying Q + calendar link, 3) Thanks + invite to onboarding webinar.

sam: For routing: HubSpot requirements: map utm_campaign -> hs_campaign, map email -> contact property, and create workflow that assigns lead owner = "Launch SDRs" if utm_campaign == "may_upgrade". Can we publish the mapping here?

oscar: Sample mapping pasted: ```
utm_campaign -> hs_campaign
utm_source -> hs_source
email -> contact.email
name -> contact.firstname
```
I'll also add a filter for source==x_social to assign to X-channel queue.

publish-bot: Reminder: scheduled post windows for the launch are editable until 4h before publish. Next scheduled run: 2024-05-28 11:00 UTC.

sam: OK timeline: drafts due EOD today, asset export by 10am tomorrow, routing & HS workflow implemented by tomorrow PM. Publish windows I'm proposing (UTC):
- 2024-05-28 11:00 - X organic (gif) + pinned reply (signup)
- 2024-05-28 11:15 - X thread (variant A)
- 2024-05-28 13:00 - LinkedIn carousel (static)
- 2024-05-28 14:00 - Paid X ad (variant B)

ria: I'll upload LinkedIn copy to /campaigns/may-upgrade/docs and tag @tess for assets.

oscar: Drafts uploaded to /campaigns/may-upgrade/copy — included both CTA variants and suggested hashtags.

tess: Assets exported to /campaigns/may-upgrade/assets (gif_1200x675.mp4, thumb_a.png, thumb_b.png). Left notes on required aspect ratios for each placement.

sam: Last piece: engagement follow-up cadence for organic replies: 1) comment reply within 1h (SDR templated), 2) if DM requested link -> immediate calendar link, 3) mark contact in HubSpot with property "interacted_social=true". Tess/oscar/ria please confirm youre comfortable with the cadence.

oscar: Confirmed. Ill add pinned-reply text and the comment templates to the copy doc.

ria: Confirmed. Ill include recommended hashtags and a suggested CTA split for LinkedIn.

tess: Confirmed on asset sizes and GIF selection.

sam: Great. Locking plan in 4h unless objections. If anything changes ping me here and update the campaign docs. :rocket:
thread_summary: Launch social plan for May product upgrade: copy owners, assets choices (GIF/static), CTA A/B test, UTM mapping and HubSpot routing, plus engagement/follow-up templates and publish windows.
